narrative.overview: The month reads like the green guide sign before an exit: each category with what is left, set large and right-aligned like mileage. Sign green carries the shell and the one sign; yellow means over budget; blue carries information; orange warns; red marks errors. Overpass is the only face; panels are flat with one border.
keyCharacteristics: One sign per screen at most

rules.name: The One Reserved Ink Rule
rules.body: Yellow means over budget and nothing else. It appears only on green or blue grounds. On white surfaces "over" is stop red.

rules.name: The Idle Grey Rule
rules.body: Categories with nothing spent print in Sign Legend at weight 600, never in yellow or green emphasis.

rules.name: The Sign Family Rule
rules.body: Notices borrow the sign families: orange for attention, red for errors, each with a 2px inner keyline (an outline at a negative offset); blue and green panels likewise.

rules.name: The Right-Aligned Mileage Rule
rules.body: Figures sit at the right edge of their line, bold, never wrapped; the name wraps at spaces on the left.

rules.name: The Never Truncate Rule
rules.body: Text in tables and lists is never cut with an ellipsis or a fixed width; it wraps at spaces, and short values stay on one line.

rules.name: The Guide Words Rule
rules.body: In Transactions the day header is sticky at the top of the scroll, on the ground colour with a 2px sign-green rule under it and that day's total at the right.

rules.name: The Keyline Rule
rules.body: The inner white or ink keyline is the sign's border. Draw it with an outline at a negative offset, not a second element.

rules.name: The In-Place State Rule
rules.body: A state restyles the row where it stands. Rows do not move to another list to show state.

rules.name: The Pace Tick Rule
rules.body: Each pace rule has a 3px tick that marks today's day of the month, shown only for the current month.

dos: Do keep yellow (#ffcc00) for over budget only, and only on green or blue grounds.
Do right-align figures at the line's edge, bold, on one line.
Do use the drawn SVG icons in Icon.tsx for arrows, checks, warnings and more.
Do let a state restyle the row in place.
Do wrap text at spaces and size columns to content; check new tables at 375px.
Do build light and dark from the same tokens; sign green stays the same in both.
donts: Don't use yellow for emphasis, hover, selection or decoration.
Don't add a second sign to a screen or use green panels for ordinary content.
Don't truncate text with ellipses, clips or fixed widths, or hide it in a tooltip.
Don't use glyph or emoji icons, kickers above headings, or hard offset shadows.
Don't use a donut chart or a row of hero-metric cards for the month.
